title: Repeat Loops
summary: `repeat ... until condition` runs the body first, then checks — guaranteeing at least one iteration, and stopping when the condition becomes true.

syntax:
repeat
    -- body runs, THEN condition is checked
until condition   -- stops when condition is TRUE

details.heading: Scope quirk
details.body: The `until` expression can see locals declared inside the body — unique among Lua constructs.

explanation.whatItIs: The mirror image of `while`: do the thing, then ask 'should I stop?'. `until` reads like English — repeat *until* we're done.
explanation.whyItExists: Some jobs must happen at least once before you can check: 'try once, retry until it works'.
whenToUse: Retry logic: repeat an attempt until it succeeds
Menus: show the menu, then loop until the player picks an option
Any loop where the exit condition depends on something computed in the body
whenNotToUse: When the condition is already known before the first run — `while` is clearer then
Never in tight loops without yielding, same as `while`
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
repeat
    body        -- always happens at least once
until done      -- stops when done == true
```
Note the inversion: `until true` STOPS; `while true` KEEPS GOING.
tips: Say the condition out loud with 'until' — if it reads backwards, you inverted it
commonMistakes: Flipping the logic: writing `until not finished` when you meant `until finished`
Forgetting that `until condition == true` stops the loop — opposite of while
Infinite repeat because the exit condition never becomes true

examples.title: Retry until success
examples.code:
local attempts = 0
local success = false

repeat
    attempts += 1
    -- pretend this sometimes fails
    success = math.random() > 0.7
    print(`Attempt {attempts}: {success}`)
    task.wait(0.5)
until success or attempts >= 10

print(if success then "Worked!" else "Gave up after 10 tries")
examples.whyItWorks: The loop stops on the first successful attempt, or after the safety cap of 10 — the `or attempts >= 10` is your guard against forever.
